author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Add the pattern detection layer that turns reports + firehose events into observed clusters: image-hash bursts (SimHash), sock-puppet cohorts (MinHash), report-volume anomalies. Pattern dashboard becomes the default home view (design.md §5.1). Pattern actions land here (design.md §5.3). Maps to design.md §11 M2.

**Children (6).** Event-bus abstraction (Kafka/NATS feature-gated); SimHash dedup; MinHash cohort detection; anomaly bands; pattern dashboard UI; pattern action endpoints with senior co-sign.

**Done when.** A moderator sees clustered incidents on the pattern dashboard, can drill in, and can act on a cluster with senior co-sign gating. Synthetic fixtures replay the design.md §3.2 invariants.

**Rust-quality.**
- Pattern engine is a service trait — `polars` / `simhash` / `probminhash` are *implementations*, not the public surface.
- Algorithmic constants (rolling-window sizes, similarity thresholds, anomaly Z-scores) live in named config, never inline literals.
- Streaming code uses `Stream` trait properly; no `.collect::<Vec<_>>()` of unbounded inputs.
